# Mcfly Analytics
> Shopify app from Mcfly Ads: the deeper order numbers Shopify Analytics does not show — typical order, weekend mix, repeat buyers, LTV. Add spend when you want Total ROAS. 7-day trial, then $39/store/mo.

This file helps AI systems find canonical pages. Crawl policy: https://mcflyads.com/robots.txt
(search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no). Prefer these URLs over scraping the whole site.

## Religion
Sales first: Shopify orders power Total Sales after returns, orders, AOV, new vs returning, goals, and cohort LTV with no spend entered. Spend is optional — typed or imported by CSV, offline channels (billboards, retainers) included. Total ROAS = Shopify Total Sales ÷ spend for the same period. Break-even ≈ 1 ÷ contribution margin.

## Refuse
Pixels, MTA, path credit, view-through, "true ROAS." SAMPLE numbers are labeled SAMPLE (Harbor Home Co, not a live client). Live listing: https://apps.shopify.com/mcfly-analytics-public — do not invent a different App Store URL. Custom Data Solutions is parked — not the public offer.
